coordinateConvention: imageX/imageY normalized, origin at top left; world in metres, Z up; at=(frame-first)/(last-first)

cupFrameRemap.note: Exact rigid geometric remap of native cached positions; rotating-frame simulation omits Coriolis, Euler and centrifugal forces.

boundaryClearanceM.note: An open-side clearance below two cells can indicate already clipped liquid. Do not tighten that side based on this bake.

quality.inCupVolumeDefinition: Volume of complete connected components touching the cup interior. A still-connected pouring stream is included; this is not exact spatial integration inside the bowl.
quality.imageBoundsDefinition: Conservative normalized image bounds from all eight world-axis-aligned mesh bounding-box corners; top-left origin. Can overestimate silhouette extent.
quality.interpretation: Volume can leave the open domain. Surface reconstruction and voxel size limit contact accuracy. Zero impacts means this bake did not resolve suitable detached drops; increase resolution or revise real cup motion rather than adding synthetic impacts.
